notes.title: A Sleeper's Quest: Final Beta Touch Ups!!
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]Hello everyone!!![/b][/u][/h2]

[u][b]First off, thank you for your interest in A Sleeper's Quest: A Labyrinth to Thee!!![/b][/u] 

This game has been a trip to design and put together, but I'm hoping players can get a unique, simple, challenging, fun and frustrating experience that you can look back at and shake your head while smiling.

Even though the game will be releasing in Early Access, the game is playable start to finish. The main idea of Early Access is to polish the game and continue to add puzzles and challenges until the maze feels right more than it already does.

As Early Access players, [b][u]PLEASE feel free to comment and post what you like, what you don't like, what you would like to see, etc.[/u][/b] Your feedback means everything to me and even though I may not implement your ideas and suggestions, there is a plan for more Sleeper Quests, so you never know what the future may hold.

Looking to release into Early Access in March, I'm working to pick a specific date so throw A Sleeper's Quest into your Wishlist and get ready for a new experience! I really can't wait for you all to get lost in The Cradle!!

See you all soon!

J
